# stalwart_http_form (Data Source)

Configures the contact form submission endpoint. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `default_from_address` (String) The default e-mail address to use when the sender does not provide one.
- `default_name` (String) The default name to use when the sender does not provide one.
- `default_subject` (String) The default subject to use when the sender does not provide one.
- `deliver_to` (Set of String) List of local e-mail addresses to deliver the contact form to.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable contact form submissions.
- `field_email` (String) The name of the field in the contact form that contains the e-mail address of the sender.
- `field_honey_pot` (String) The name of the field in the contact form that is used as a honey pot to catch spam bots.
- `field_name` (String) The name of the field in the contact form that contains the name of the sender.
- `field_subject` (String) The name of the field in the contact form that contains the subject of the message.
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum size of the contact form submission in bytes.
- `rate_limit` (Attributes) Maximum number of contact form submissions that can be made in a timeframe by a given IP address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limit))
- `validate_domain` (Boolean) Whether to validate the domain of the sender's email address.

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limit`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) Count
- `period` (Number) Period
